name: io.github.borgels/mcp-server-planday
title: Planday
description: Unofficial MCP server for the Planday Open API: departments, employees, schedule and punch clock.

environmentVariables.name: PLANDAY_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The Planday app's App Id (Settings > Integrations > API Access).

environmentVariables.name: PLANDAY_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The Planday app's Token (a refresh token).

environmentVariables.name: PLANDAY_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path of the JSONL audit log. Write tools refuse to run if it cannot be written.
